<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed entity data'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment testing CDATA and namespaces combined -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <tags> and &internal; reference.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY foo "Bar">
  <!ENTITY baz "&foo; &foo;">
  <!ENTITY % prm "<!ENTITY deep 'nested parameter entity'>">
  %prm;
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with &foo;?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/m">
  <!-- Top comment block -->
  <m:section m:att="val">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside a namespace-qualified element with &baz; reference.
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <section>&deep;</section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "Anonymous">
  <!ENTITY msg "Hello World">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY extfile SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<note xmlns="http://w3.org/schools/note" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment: receiver -->
  <to>Toshio</to>
  <from>&writer;</from>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Body content with CDATA and reference: &msg;
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```

  <!ELEMENT test (node+)>

  <!ENTITY entB "Beta &entA;">

  %macroB;
]>
<?xml-log type="audit" user="admin"?>
<test xmlns="http://example.org/test" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment introducing nodes -->
  <ns:node ns:version="1.0">

      Testing CDATA with &entB; and &entC;
    ]]>
  </ns:node>
  <node>&entC;</node>
</test>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE report [
  <!ELEMENT report (summary, details)>
  <!ELEMENT summary (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT details (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY status "OK">
  <!ENTITY warning "Warning: &status;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docpdf SYSTEM "report.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-client name="checker" version="2.0"?>
<report xmlns="http://example.com/report" xmlns:rep="http://example.com/report/details">
  <!-- Summary comment -->
  <summary>&warning;</summary>
  <rep:details>
    <![CDATA[
      Detailed report log data block with symbols <, >, &, and "quotes".
    ]]>
  </rep:details>
</report>

<!DOCTYPE configuration [

  <setting>
    <![CDATA[
      Timeout configuration: &timeout; seconds.
    ]]>
  </setting>
</configuration>
